title: knowledge.written v1 — a file-tool write into a knowledge source

contenthash.description: SHA-256 of the on-disk file after the write, truncated to 16 hex chars; only when kbroot != null and file <= 5 MB, null on harvest-mined writes (G2-5, ADR-0030)

size.description: File size in bytes, recorded when the file exceeds the 5 MB hash cap (ADR-0030)

raw.description: Agent-native payload minus written content: tool_input's content/old_string/new_string/new_source are stripped and replaced by <field>_size byte counts (ADR-0030)
